outcome.technical: The doctor's pin rows now judge each route by the drive's own reader over the copy the drive asks for that route. _doctor_policy._pin_routes names the routes from the config (executor.writerModel, executor.waveWidth): the project's working copy for 'a session run in this tree' or 'a subagent dispatched from this tree', and on the session route at a wave width above one also 'a wave's sessions', judged over HEAD's copy. Every row is prefixed 'for <route>:' and its fix is that route's (_pin_fix: a wave's skill held by a commit is told to commit; the working-copy route is told to restore where it reads). Both routes call _skill_places.pin_verdict, the function the drive calls. The git-status reader (_head_note, _under) is deleted; its stale GIT_PATH_BASE_EXEMPT row in tools/lints/_deps.py is deleted with it (a file outside the task's files list; the plan gate allowed the edit). HEAD's copy is read by _in_head_copy / _cut_head_copy: git rev-parse, then read-tree into a PRIVATE index file and checkout-index into a scratch directory under the temp directory, removed in a finally; nothing is written to the project, its .git or .git/worktrees. A copy that cannot be cut (no git, no repository, no commit, no scratch dir, git failed, temp dir inside the repository) is a WARNING row 'for a wave's sessions: not judged: <why>', and a scratch directory that could not be removed is its own warning. I chose this over a second `git worktree add --detach` (which checkout_at uses) because it needs no .git/worktrees entry, runs no post-checkout hook and so cannot leave a registration if the doctor is killed; the cost is that the bytes come from read-tree/checkout-index rather than the identical git operation, which I measured equal over core.autocrlf=true, text eol=crlf, -text and a committed directory link (S/sg2.26/exp_checkout.py: SAME in all four) and which dp70/dp71 hold against the real drive. The words of a stop for a copy that is not the project's moved out of drive-phase.py into _skill_places (commit_label, loaded_tier, copy_remedy, copy_stop_words; loaded_tier uses _inside instead of _worktrees.within_tree, same containment on resolved paths); drive-phase.pin_stop_words now calls copy_stop_words and the drive's four private helpers are gone, so the runner's stop and the doctor's wave row are one sentence (dp70 asserts the doctor's words occur verbatim in the drive's output). Tests: tests/test__doctor_policy.py gained a scenario block that builds real git projects and runs BOTH audit-doctor.py --json and drive-phase.py next on each (dp70, dp70b link layout and its committed twin, dp71, dp71b autocrlf and twin, dp72, dp72b, dp72c working-copy-only edit on the session and subagent routes and the matching twin, dp73 no pins draws no row, dp74 .git byte-for-byte, worktree list and private TMPDIR unchanged after the doctor runs, dp75, dp75b not-judged, dp76 a personal skill is not told to commit); dp68 rewritten for the route rows, dp68b asserts no git-status text and no _head_note. tests/test__skill_places.py gained sp52-sp55. tests/test_drive_phase.py: spd33a now calls _skill_places.commit_label (the driver no longer defines it).
